summary.text: Tad Jude is the Republican nominee for Minnesota Secretary of State. A Maple Grove attorney and former district court judge, he served in the Minnesota House and Senate in the 1970s and 1980s and ran unsuccessfully for Congress in 2024; he is campaigning on photo ID, using the federal SAVE database for voter rolls and a vote to restore the 1983 state flag.

paragraphs.text: District court judge in Minnesota's 10th judicial district from January 2011 to January 2022, per the Minnesota Legislative Reference Library.
Served in the Minnesota House of Representatives (1973-1982) and Senate (1983-1988, elected as a DFL member), and was an unsuccessful candidate for Minnesota's 3rd congressional district in 2024.
Self-employed attorney and small-business owner living in Maple Grove.
